claims.claim: The roadmap records CAA-04 / TASK-414 r2 as the sole current NEXT, preserves the published CAA-03 selection as history, and records its TASK-412 r2 / RUN-412-009 accepted lineage.

The new caller-invoked evaluation API accepts the existing four-flow packet, subject, candidate, fingerprint and sealed ExperienceCut; its outputs are bounded JSON data and it has no lifecycle writer.

Separate development, holdout and shadow cohorts bind exact source, subject, candidate and as-of identities. Independent labels stay outside advisor input, and consultation uses the existing sealed-cut and current-source guards.

Grading requires independent Human label provenance and evaluates material citations, causal applicability, counterexamples, abstention and harmful confidence. Provider failures and rejected responses receive UNKNOWN grades rather than abstention credit.
The shadow session is disabled by default, requires caller opt-in, makes at most one selected consultation per subject, and returns observation data without changing direct Brain workflow state.

Decisive holdout and shadow calls require an exact preregistered Human plan matched to a trusted supplier, prescribed provider and reservation gate. The implementation enforces ceilings of 50 subjects, seven days and one selected call per subject.

Reports separate baseline and advisor observations, measured, estimated and UNKNOWN values, quality, safety, cost, latency percentiles and episode outcomes, and state sample limitations, missingness, confounders and UNKNOWN production uplift.

The fixtures exercise all four flows and adversarial source, citation, label, injection, provenance, budget, timeout and rollout cases. A successor-safe positive and forged-negative regression compares preserved CAA-03 history with its published source.

The Human rollout packet presents independent grader provenance, threshold observations, unknowns, alternatives and stop gates with authority NONE; it requires a separate exact Human decision for production rollout.

The commit changes exactly the five authorized paths. The inherited CAA-03 test and existing CAA modules remain unchanged; TASK-414 r2's authored three-file command excludes exactly the named historical source-cut test.
